providers.provider_name: Public Service Company of New Mexico (PNM)
providers.service_territory: Greater Albuquerque, Rio Rancho, Los Lunas, Belen, Santa Fe, Las Vegas, Alamogordo, Ruidoso, Silver City, Deming, Bayard, Lordsburg, Clayton, and NM Tribal communities; 550,000+ customers statewide
providers.notes: Largest IOU in New Mexico; NMPRC-regulated; phased rate increase approved 2025 (Docket 24-00089-UT). Business EE programs administered by third-party program manager at 2440 Louisiana Blvd NE, Suite 301, Albuquerque, NM 87110.

providers.service_territory: Southern New Mexico — Doña Ana, Sierra, Otero, and Luna Counties (Las Cruces, El Paso metro border area)
providers.notes: Second-largest NM IOU; serves west Texas and southern NM. Rate tariffs filed with NMPRC. Commercial programs branded 'EPESaver'. Transportation Electrification Plan (TEP) 2024-2026 budget $11.8M.

providers.service_territory: Estancia Valley / Torrance County area (Moriarty, Estancia, Edgewood, McIntosh and surrounding communities)
providers.notes: Member-owned rural electric cooperative. Offers commercial LED lighting, refrigerated/freezer case LED, pole-mounted LED, and irrigation rebates. Also EV charger, heat pump, smart thermostat rebates.

providers.service_territory: McKinley, Cibola, Sandoval, and Valencia Counties in west-central New Mexico (Gallup area)
providers.notes: Rural electric cooperative. Offers commercial EV charging rebates (Level 2: up to $1,000; DCFC: up to $7,500) and residential efficiency rebates.

providers.service_territory: North-central New Mexico — Los Alamos, Rio Arriba, and Sandoval Counties (Española, Chimayó, Abiquiú, Los Alamos area)
providers.notes: Rural electric cooperative. Offers commercial EV charging rebates (Level 2: up to $1,000; DCFC: up to $7,500). Contact cooperative directly for full commercial rebate details.

programs.provider_name: Public Service Company of New Mexico (PNM)
programs.program_notes_ai: Prescriptive rebates cover lighting (interior, exterior, dusk-to-dawn, 12-hr operation), HVAC, motors, and refrigeration from a pre-set menu. Custom rebates pay ~$0.08/kWh of estimated first-year savings for measures not on the prescriptive menu. Eligible rate classes: Small Power (2A/2B), General Power (3B/3C), Large Power (4B), Water/Sewage (11B), Mining. PNM Authorized Contractors can submit applications on behalf of customers. Applications submitted through pnmenergyefficiency.com online portal.

programs.provider_name: Public Service Company of New Mexico (PNM)
programs.program_notes_ai: Whole-building approach: 10–20% savings above ASHRAE 90.1-2016 earns $0.10/kWh; >20% savings earns $0.12/kWh. Lighting new construction rebates calculated at $0.30/watt reduced based on LPD vs. ASHRAE 90.1-2007 baseline. Enhanced commissioning rebates also available. Pre-approval required before construction begins. All PNM commercial, industrial, and government customers on eligible rate classes qualify.

programs.provider_name: Public Service Company of New Mexico (PNM)
programs.program_notes_ai: Streamlined/express track for smaller commercial customers. Part of PNM's three-component Business EE portfolio alongside Retrofit Rebate and New Construction. Simplifies application process for quick installation projects.

programs.provider_name: Public Service Company of New Mexico (PNM)
programs.program_notes_ai: Rebates designed specifically for multifamily communities with savings incentives available for income-qualified properties, in-unit upgrades, and common-area upgrades. Includes both market-rate and income-qualified affordable housing tracks.

programs.provider_name: Public Service Company of New Mexico (PNM)
programs.rebate_payment_method: Upstream discount at point of sale
programs.program_notes_ai: Authorized equipment distributors sell eligible high-efficiency equipment at a point-of-sale discount funded by PNM. Available to eligible commercial or industrial PNM customers purchasing through authorized distributor network. No post-purchase rebate application needed.

programs.provider_name: Public Service Company of New Mexico (PNM)
programs.program_notes_ai: Incentives available for small, medium, and large commercial buildings using a whole-building approach to optimize building performance and improve facility efficiency. Offered through PNM Authorized Contractors who perform the building assessment and tune-up measures.

programs.provider_name: Public Service Company of New Mexico (PNM)
programs.stacking_rules: SEM can be combined with Retrofit Rebate and other programs; contact program team for details
programs.rebate_payment_method: No cash rebate — program is provided as a free service funded through customer bills
programs.program_notes_ai: Free organizational training, O&M improvement support, and energy monitoring/reporting tools for C&I customers using 1.5M kWh/year or more. Utilizes Plan-Do-Check-Act continuous improvement methodology. SEM Coaching Team provides facilitated site-specific events and management system implementation. Fully funded through the 'Cost-Effective Energy Saving Program' line item on electric bills.

programs.stacking_rules: Federal, state, or other funding sources considered when reviewing rebate applications
programs.funding_status: Open — first come, first served until funding exhausted
programs.rebate_payment_method: Check (to customer or assigned to contractor)
programs.program_notes_ai: Available to EPE NM commercial customers with average demand ≤100 kW. Covers HVAC (cooling), cool roofs, lighting, and other measures. AHRI-certified equipment required for HVAC. Applications submitted via EPE online portal or mailed to EPE Rebate Processing Center. EPE reserves the right to adjust programs at any time; all rebates subject to Program Manager approval.

programs.program_name: EPESaver Commercial HVAC Cooling Rebate Program (2025)
programs.stacking_rules: Federal, state, or other funding considered when reviewing applications
programs.rebate_payment_method: Check (to customer or assigned to licensed contractor)
programs.program_notes_ai: Covers retrofit cooling system upgrades and new construction installation of energy-efficient cooling systems. Requires AHRI-certified equipment and licensed HVAC contractor. 2025 application form (Rev. 1/13/2025) available as PDF. Customer must allow EPE or Frontier Energy site inspection if contacted. Project must not have been completed with lower efficiency without EPE program assistance (additionality attestation required).

programs.program_name: EPESaver Commercial Cool Roof Rebate Program (2025)
programs.stacking_rules: Federal, state, or other funding considered when reviewing applications
programs.rebate_payment_method: Check (to customer or assigned to contractor)
programs.program_notes_ai: Rebates paid per square foot of installed cool roof materials. All EPE commercial and industrial NM customers eligible. Applications may be submitted online (EPE portal) or mailed to EPE Rebate Processing Center. EPE reserves right to adjust programs at any time.

programs.program_name: EPE NM Commercial EV Smart Charging Rebate Program (2025)
required_documents: Proof of smart charging capability (OpenADR or OCPP)
programs.stacking_rules: Other federal/state funding sources considered when reviewing; schools, transit, fleet, MUD projects may receive up to 100% of costs
programs.program_notes_ai: Part of EPE's NMPRC-approved Transportation Electrification Plan (TEP) 2024-2026 with $11.8M budget. Covers 240V outlets, Level 2, and AC/DC fast charging stations purchased after April 1, 2024. Equipment must be NRTL-certified and include smart charging (OpenADR or OCPP). Schools, public transit, fleets, and MUD projects may receive up to 100% of project costs. Customer must share charging data with EPE. DCFC rebates: 50-75 kW up to $3,000; 76-149 kW up to $5,000; 150+ kW up to $7,500.

programs.program_name: CNMEC Commercial LED Lighting Rebate Program (2025)
programs.program_notes_ai: CNMEC offers commercial rebates for: Commercial LED Lighting, Pole-Mounted LED Lighting, Refrigerated/Freezer Case LED Lighting, and Irrigation. Also offers non-commercial rebates for heat pumps, EV chargers, smart thermostats, and evaporative coolers. Contact cooperative directly for current rebate amounts and forms.

programs.program_name: CDEC Commercial EV Charging Rebate Program (2025)
programs.program_notes_ai: Commercial businesses can receive up to $1,000 for Level 2 EV charging projects and up to $7,500 for DC Fast Charging installations. Residential Level 2 rebate is $250 (up to 50% of total cost). Contact CDEC directly for full commercial program details and application forms.

programs.program_name: JMEC Commercial EV Charging Rebate Program (2025)
programs.program_notes_ai: Businesses can receive up to $1,000 for Level 2 EV charging and up to $7,500 for DC Fast Charging. Residential: $250 for non-managed Level 2 charger, up to $1,000 for managed charger. Contact JMEC directly for full commercial application requirements and current rebate schedule.

rate_schedules.provider_name: Public Service Company of New Mexico (PNM)
rate_schedules.description: Small commercial/industrial service with no demand charge. Customers exceeding 15,000 kWh or 50 kW for 3 months in 12-month period are transferred to Rate 3B or 3C. Eligible for Retrofit and New Construction rebate programs.
rate_schedules.notes: Phased rate increase per NMPRC Docket 24-00089-UT: Phase 1 effective July 1, 2025; full increase effective April 1, 2026. Exact $/kWh rates require current tariff sheet retrieval from pnm.com/rates2.

rate_schedules.provider_name: Public Service Company of New Mexico (PNM)
rate_schedules.schedule_name: Rate No. 2B — Small Power Service Time-of-Use
rate_schedules.description: TOU variant of Rate 2A for small commercial customers. Customers transferred to Rate 3B/3C once they exceed 15,000 kWh or 50 kW for 3 months in a 12-month rolling period.
rate_schedules.notes: 26th Revised Rate No. 2B effective April 1, 2026 per NMPRC Docket 24-00089-UT. Exact on-peak/off-peak $/kWh requires current tariff sheet from pnm.com/rates2.

rate_schedules.provider_name: Public Service Company of New Mexico (PNM)
rate_schedules.schedule_name: Rate No. 3B — General Power Service TOU
rate_schedules.description: Primary TOU rate for general commercial/industrial/lighting/water & sewage customers. Requires average monthly load factor >35% AND on-peak kW ≥50 kW for 3 months OR consumption ≥15,000 kWh for 3 months in prior 12 months. Monthly minimum demand 50 kW. Most general commercial customers served under this schedule.
rate_schedules.notes: 25th Revised Rate No. 3B; NMPRC Docket 24-00089-UT. Full rate increase effective April 1, 2026. Exact $/kW demand and $/kWh TOU energy rates require current tariff PDF from pnm.com/rates2.

rate_schedules.provider_name: Public Service Company of New Mexico (PNM)
rate_schedules.schedule_name: Rate No. 3C — General Power Service (Low Load Factor)
rate_schedules.description: Designed for commercial customers with low load factor (≤35% average monthly). Alternative to Rate 3B for qualifying general power customers. Lower load factor results in higher $/kWh but lower demand charge structure.
rate_schedules.notes: Part of NMPRC Docket 24-00089-UT rate case. Exact tariff values require current PDF from pnm.com/rates2.

rate_schedules.provider_name: Public Service Company of New Mexico (PNM)
rate_schedules.description: For large commercial and industrial customers exceeding Rate 3B thresholds. Includes TOU energy pricing and demand charges. Eligible for SEM program (if ≥1.5M kWh/yr).
rate_schedules.notes: Subject to NMPRC Docket 24-00089-UT full rate increase effective April 1, 2026. Exact $/kW and $/kWh values require current tariff PDF from pnm.com/rates2.

rate_schedules.provider_name: Public Service Company of New Mexico (PNM)
rate_schedules.schedule_name: Rate No. 5B — Large Power Service (≥8,000 kW)
rate_schedules.description: For very large industrial customers with minimum demand ≥8,000 kW. High-voltage transmission service. Economic Development Rider may apply. Also see Rate 30B and 35B for high-voltage/manufacturing variants.
rate_schedules.notes: Subject to NMPRC Docket 24-00089-UT. Exact rates require current tariff PDF. Customers on this schedule likely qualify for SEM program.

rate_schedules.provider_name: Public Service Company of New Mexico (PNM)
rate_schedules.schedule_name: Rate No. 6 — Private Area Lighting Service
rate_schedules.description: Rate schedule for private outdoor/area lighting service. Typically per-fixture monthly charge structure covering PNM-owned streetlight and area lighting equipment.
rate_schedules.notes: Rate No. 6 listed in NMPRC Docket 24-00089-UT tariff revision schedule. Exact per-fixture rates require current tariff PDF from pnm.com/rates2.

rate_schedules.provider_name: Public Service Company of New Mexico (PNM)
rate_schedules.description: Seasonal irrigation service rate for agricultural pumping customers. Typically available April–October (irrigation season) with lower off-season rates.
rate_schedules.notes: Listed in NMPRC Docket 24-00089-UT tariff schedule. Exact seasonal $/kWh and $/kW demand rates require current tariff PDF from pnm.com/rates2.

rate_schedules.provider_name: Public Service Company of New Mexico (PNM)
rate_schedules.description: TOU variant of Rate 10A for irrigation customers wishing to shift pumping to off-peak hours for bill savings. Eligible for CNMEC-style irrigation rebates where applicable.
rate_schedules.notes: Listed in NMPRC Docket 24-00089-UT. Exact TOU rates require current tariff PDF from pnm.com/rates2.

rate_schedules.provider_name: Public Service Company of New Mexico (PNM)
rate_schedules.schedule_name: Rate No. 11B — Water & Sewage Pumping Service
rate_schedules.description: Special rate for water and sewage pumping operations (municipal utilities, water districts, sanitation districts). Eligible for PNM Retrofit Rebate and New Construction programs.
rate_schedules.notes: Listed in NMPRC Docket 24-00089-UT tariff schedule. Exact rates require current tariff PDF from pnm.com/rates2.

rate_schedules.description: Standard small commercial service for EPE NM customers. No demand charge; energy-only billing. Fixed monthly customer charge of $7.00. EV Whole-House rate rider (WSEV) available under Rates 03, 04, and 07.
rate_schedules.notes: Tariff schedules available as PDFs at EPE's NM Rate Tariffs page. Official tariffs on file with NMPRC. Call (575) 526-5555 or 1-800-351-1621 for current rate values.

rate_schedules.description: EPE NM medium commercial service with demand charge billing. WSEV EV rate rider available. Eligible for EPESaver commercial rebate programs.
rate_schedules.notes: Official tariff on file with NMPRC. Exact $/kWh and $/kW values available at epelectric.com NM Rate Tariffs page or by calling (575) 526-5555.

rate_schedules.schedule_name: Rate No. 07 — Large Commercial / Industrial Service
rate_schedules.description: EPE NM large commercial and industrial TOU service. WSEV EV rate rider available. Eligible for EPESaver commercial rebate programs.
rate_schedules.notes: Official tariff on file with NMPRC. FPPCAC fuel adjustment applies monthly. Exact rates available at epelectric.com NM Rate Tariffs or by calling (575) 526-5555.

rate_schedules.description: EPE NM residential service (14th Revised Rate No. 01). Serves Doña Ana, Sierra, Otero, and Luna Counties. TOD (time-of-day) rates apply after meter re-programming per NMPRC Case No. 20-00104-UT. WHEV incentive credit for EV owners. Included for reference as benchmark.
rate_schedules.notes: Residential reference rate. Fixed customer charge $7.00/month. TOD on-peak/off-peak energy rates apply per NMPRC order.

rate_schedules.schedule_name: Rate No. 47 — Community Solar Program Credit Rate (NM)
rate_schedules.description: First Revised Rate No. 47 — NM Community Solar Program (CSP) credit rate. Fixed CSP credit rate as of March 19, 2025 until reset by NMPRC order. FPPCAC (Rate 18) and RPS Cost Rider (Rate 38) also apply. Available to any retail electric service customer or rural electric co-op that has opted into community solar.
rate_schedules.notes: Credit rate fixed as of March 19, 2025. FPPCAC varies monthly — see current rates at epelectric.com/customer-service/rates-and-regulations.

forms.provider_name: Public Service Company of New Mexico (PNM)
forms.form_name: PNM Business Energy Efficiency Online Application (Retrofit)
forms.form_notes: Online application portal — primary submission method for all Retrofit Rebate projects. PNM Authorized Contractors may also submit on behalf of customers. Policies and Procedures document available at same URL.

forms.provider_name: Public Service Company of New Mexico (PNM)
forms.form_name: PNM Business Energy Efficiency Online Application (New Construction)
forms.form_notes: Online application — same portal as Retrofit. New Construction Policies and Procedures document linked at application-tools page. Pre-approval required before project completion.

forms.provider_name: Public Service Company of New Mexico (PNM)
forms.form_notes: Streamlined online application form for QuickSaver express track. Accessible through the main PNM EE application portal.

forms.provider_name: Public Service Company of New Mexico (PNM)
forms.form_notes: Submitted via the main PNM EE online application portal. Separate application tracks for market-rate and income-qualified affordable properties.

forms.provider_name: Public Service Company of New Mexico (PNM)
forms.form_notes: Application submitted through authorized PNM Contractor via online portal. Pre-approval required.

forms.program_name: EPESaver Commercial HVAC Cooling Rebate Program (2025)
forms.form_name: 2025 EPE NM Commercial HVAC Rebate Application Form
forms.form_notes: Rev. 1/13/2025. Customer signs to attest installation, allow site inspection by EPE or Frontier Energy, and confirm additionality. Contractor assignment of rebate payment available. Mail to EPE Rebate Processing Center or submit online.

forms.form_name: EPE NM Commercial Rebate Application (Online Portal)
forms.form_notes: Submit online via EPE's rebate portal or mail to EPE Rebate Processing Center. Digital copies of invoice/receipt and additional installation documentation required. Select 'Customer' option after registering and confirming email.

forms.program_name: EPESaver Commercial Cool Roof Rebate Program (2025)
forms.form_name: EPE NM Cool Roof Rebate Application
forms.form_notes: Applications may be submitted online or by email. Mail to EPE Rebate Processing Center with copy of receipt/invoice. All rebates subject to Program Manager approval.

forms.program_name: EPE NM Commercial EV Smart Charging Rebate Program (2025)
forms.form_name: EPE NM Commercial Smart Charging Rebate Application (Fillable PDF)
forms.form_notes: Complete fillable application and submit via email to ev@epelectric.com. Must include proof of installation after April 1, 2024, NRTL certification, passing city inspection proof, and smart charging capability documentation.

forms.program_name: CNMEC Commercial LED Lighting Rebate Program (2025)
forms.form_notes: PDF rebate forms available on CNMEC member rebates page. Evaporative Cooler Rebate Form 2025 confirmed available. Commercial forms for LED lighting categories available at same page. Contact CNMEC directly for current commercial form links.
